defects.statement: ST-0 was in frustum on 1 of 8 crossing-strip frames (7/432 samples) — the strip proved the state machine, not the crossing. A blind viewer independently reported 'nothing crosses; it reads as a frozen game'.

defects.statement: A blind viewer given the final ST-0 still could not find ST-0 at all. Measured: the brightest sky pixel in the frame is the crosshair (245); stars top out at 225-230; ST-0 is not distinguished. The eye goes instead to a lime-green ragged patch that reads as broken art. The chapter's first perception is not perceivable in its own hero still.
defects.requestedRepair: Rule whether ST-0's authored luminance is wrong or the still's staging is; the contract's reachability sentence claiming ST-0 sits above the starfield peak is contradicted by two independent measurements.
defects.verificationRoute: Re-measure ST-0 peak against classified point sources after any luminance change; re-run a blind read.

notes: Severity uses the reviewers' own words. 'resolved' means a repair landed AND was proven; 'resolved-reclassified' means the finding was disproved as stated; 'open-evidence' means the fix is code-complete but its proof is outstanding with the verifier; 'open-taste' means no machine route can settle it.

D-A1 is resolved as a diagnosis but Cinematography's draft-v7 signature keeps every composition verdict in verification-report.json formally SUSPENDED until the stale strips are regenerated and re-measured. That suspension is the single largest open item against the judge's evidence base.

Cinematography also recorded, without patching it, that four sites carry a mobile occupancy figure of about 26% derived from a superseded desktop number; it must be re-derived before any verifier measures mobile occupancy against a band.
